svg.title: Álvaro Robles — semi-modular
svg.desc: A semi-modular synthesizer: a graphite faceplate with ident, oscilloscope, patch bay and output sections above a bone-coloured keyboard, with wooden end cheeks. One socket in the patch bay is not machined hardware — it is a soft aperture that contracts.

g.text: R O B L E S · S Y S T E M S
